'''Erf''' was a [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked for [[Rej Taunt]]. In [[43 ABY]], he and another Weequay working for Taunt accompanied [[Tobb Jadak]] and [[Flitcher Poste]] on a mission to [[Holess]] to capture a [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoid]] with a connection to Taunt's rival, [[Lestra Oxic]].<ref name="Millennium Falcon" />
